name: trackr
description: ForexTrackr read-only API tools: account lookup, current session, dashboard and business metrics.

firm1_url.title: Firm 1: ForexTrackr URL
firm1_url.description: The first firm's ForexTrackr address, e.g. https://trackr.example.com.

firm1_api_key.title: Firm 1: API key
firm1_api_key.description: Your trk_... key from that firm's admin (Admin Settings > User Management > API Keys).

firm2_url.title: Firm 2: ForexTrackr URL (optional)
firm2_url.description: A second firm's address; leave empty if you have one firm.

firm2_api_key.title: Firm 2: API key (optional)
firm2_api_key.description: Your trk_... key for the second firm.
